concerns.location: tasks.md:Completed work / FR coverage note vs spec.md:FR-002, FR-003, FR-025
concerns.text: FR-002 (ISRIC merge, 10 km NN interpolation), FR-003's k-NN imputation (k=5, mean fallback), and FR-025's species-mean imputation path are all dropped via the AM-001 deviation, but spec.md still mandates them. tasks.md records the deviation in artifacts/sc_amendments.json yet the active spec is never amended — the task list and spec contradict each other. Either amend the spec (with the AM-001 record) or the completed work violates standing FRs.

concerns.location: tasks.md:FR coverage note vs spec.md:SC-001, FR-023
concerns.text: SC-001 is silently redefined as 'pn_availability_rate' per AM-001 while the spec still defines merge_success_rate ≥ 0.90 against RootReader/PlantPheno. A task list may not narrow a success criterion without a corresponding spec amendment; the redefinition must be propagated to spec.md SC-001/FR-023 or the criterion remains unmet.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Completed work T013 (n≥20 filtering) vs plan.md:T010 / spec.md:FR-024, SC-009
concerns.text: Executed ingestion filters species at n≥20 (spec FR-001 threshold) while plan.md/research.md and FR-024/SC-009 require n≥30. T104 computes power but nothing enforces the ≥30 minimum on the filtered dataset, so SC-009's 'meets the required minimum sample size per species (≥30)' acceptance criterion is not carried into any task verification step.

T104 requires writing required_n_per_species and an SC-009 status into model_metrics.json's success_criteria, but the active model_results.schema.yaml success_criteria block (additionalProperties not restricted there, but the top-level has additionalProperties: false and success_criteria properties are fixed) does not define these fields; T103's contract validation will conflict with T104's outputs unless the schema is extended in a task.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Path Conventions vs plan.md:T033/T035/T036 and Constitution III/V
concerns.text: tasks.md states research scripts do NOT write to state/ files, but plan tasks T033/T035/T036 record checksums and artifact hashes in state/projects/...yaml, and Constitution III requires data/ checksums recorded in that state file. No replacement task covers checksum/hash recording under the new convention — Constitution Principles III and V are left unsatisfied by the task list.

T110 runs 'python code/data_ingestion.py' but quickstart.md documents 'python code/ingestion.py'; the documented workflow and the verification command cannot both be correct — reconcile the script name.

Spec/plan require a final PDF report (final_report.pdf); tasks.md produces only final_report.md with no PDF-compilation task and no recorded justification. If the markdown report is the intended research-stage deliverable with PDF deferred to the paper stage, say so explicitly (as done for T111's handoff) rather than silently narrowing the deliverable.

T107's bias assessment compares pre/post-filtering statistics for the exclusion policy, but FR-025's imputation path (species-mean for ≤30% missing) was replaced by exclusion per AM-001; T107's description still references 'species-mean imputation where applied'. Align the task description with the actually-executed AM-001 policy (and amend FR-025 in the spec accordingly).
